name: Wolverine Technologies Corp.
summary: Wolverine Technologies Corp. does not have significant operations. It focuses on the cyber security business. Previously, the company was involved in the identification, acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resources. The company was formerly known as Wolverine Exploration Inc. and changed its name to Wolverine Technologies Corp. in August 2015. Wolverine Technologies Corp. was founded in 2006 and is based in Richmond, Canada.
